items.title: Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India
items.summary: The limited test covers select products and users, with a broader rollout planned for later in October.

items.title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
items.summary: Blue Cross Blue Shield says hospital use of AI tools led to an additional $942M in healthcare spending over a two-year period.

items.title: I created an interactive digital avatar of myself — and you can talk to it
items.summary: After obtaining an interactive avatar and training it to discuss venture fraud, I have mixed feelings about making AI clones of ourselves.
